staticText: Private deterministic worksheet for expanded numeric linear equations in x, quadratics up to x squared, two linear equations in x and y, and one-variable linear inequalities. Parentheses, radicals, functions, variable denominators, chained inequalities, scientific notation, and powers above x squared are outside its parser contract and must be rejected rather than guessed. Graphs are illustrative; users should verify rounded answers and choose the correct equation family.
